item.title: Ronnie Bowman Dead at 64 — Bluegrass Loses One of Its Defining Voices
item.description: The bluegrass world is mourning the loss of Ronnie Bowman, a beloved singer and songwriter who helped define a generation.

item.title: Keith Urban’s Next Album Has People Asking, “Wait… What?”
item.description: The country music legend just hinted at his next album — and the direction has people doing a double take.

item.title: Jo Dee Messina's Inspiring Weight Loss Journey Revealed
item.description: Jo Dee Messina says that she knew she wanted to lose weight after realizing she 'didn't recognize myself' in photos, the singer explained during a new interview with Taste of Country Nights.

item.title: 6 Country Songs With the Word 'Die' in the Title
item.description: These six country songs combine themes of love and mortality, emphasizing that true bonds last even after death.

item.title: Little Debbie's Oatmeal Creme Pies Ice Cream Bars Set To Delight Snack Lovers
item.description: Little Debbie fans are buzzing about the new Oatmeal Creme Pies Ice Cream Bars, featuring rich creme ice cream and real cookie pieces, expected to hit stores before Easter.

item.title: WATCH: Kacey Musgraves Pranked Ronnie Dunn, Here
item.description: Dunn was totally in on the joke after Kacey Musgraves dressed up as him to perform 'Neon Moon' in a surprise moment in a downtown Nashville honky tonk.

item.description: Season 24 of American Idol is getting serious. With live shows looming, here is who is left on America's post popular singing reality show.

item.title: Alan Jackson Is a Grandpa Again — Meet Baby Charlie Ann Smith [PHOTO]
item.description: The country music icon is celebrating his new granddaughter — and he just shared a sweet photo with baby Charlie Ann Smith.

item.title: Cody Johnson Shares His Initial Reaction to Kid Rock's ''Til You Can't'
item.description: When Kid Rock first wanted to cut a version of ''Til You Can't,' Cody Johnson's response was, 'Well, maybe.' But after getting the blessing of the songwriters, and hearing why Rock wanted to record the song, he was sold.
